fullContentHtml:
Delhi High Court Higher Judicial Service HJS Mains Admit Card 2026 – Full Details

Delhi High Court Higher Judicial Service HJS Mains Admit Card 2026. Candidates who appeared in the examination can check their result and download the scorecard from the direct official link provided below. Important: 15 July 2026 is the deadline.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 01 July 2026
  • Last Date : 15 July 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 15 July 2026
  • Pre Exam Date : 26 July 2026
  • Pre Admit Card Date : 21 July 2026
  • Answer Key : 28 July 2026
  • Pre Result : 14 August 2026
  • Mains Exam Date : 10-11 October 2026
  • Mains Admit Card : 05 October 2026

Application Fee

  • General : Rs. 2000/-
  • SC, ST : Rs. 500/-

How to Check Result

  1. Click on the direct official result link provided below.
  2. Enter your Roll Number / Registration Number and Date of Birth.
  3. Submit the form to view your scorecard on screen.
  4. Download and print a copy of the result for future reference.
